objective: Persist the complete 3D Simulation workspace across refreshes or unexpected closes, ask whether to restore it at startup, and isolate independently opened simulation windows.
deliverables: Durable workspace storage for imported files, models, transforms, programs, and relevant settings
Independent workspace identity per simulation window
Explicit handling for duplicate versus newly opened windows
Safe legacy migration and storage-failure behavior
Localized UI, version record, automated tests, and real-browser verification
constraints: Preserve all existing OLP, reverse-repeat, and model-tree clipboard changes
Do not serialize live Three.js object references
Large imported files must not be stored in localStorage
Two simultaneously opened windows must not overwrite one another
The user must choose whether to restore previously saved work
Existing project import/export behavior must remain compatible
existingContext: Robot motion projects currently use a shared localStorage key
Imported 3D models are rebuilt from File objects and are not currently durable
Scene snapshots support Undo/Redo but contain live runtime references
dependencies: Imported model loaders and source File lifecycle
Browser IndexedDB, sessionStorage, and cross-tab storage semantics
unknowns: Which settings are already persisted separately
Whether every supported imported format can be restored from stored bytes without auxiliary files
How duplicated tabs should inherit or fork a workspace identity
Storage quota and partial-write recovery behavior
verificationMethod: Automated persistence, migration, and tab-isolation regression tests
Real browser refresh/restore/discard and simultaneous-window scenarios
Independent integration review and repair loop
completionCriteria: A refreshed or reopened window can restore its last durable workspace after user confirmation
Imported 3D model bytes and transforms survive restore
Choosing not to restore starts clean without destroying the saved recovery copy unintentionally
Two concurrent windows write separate workspace records
Storage failures are visible and never claim success
All automated and browser checks pass
